snippet.title: Wildixir - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5233410/Wildixir/

One failed elixir. An awakened forest. A little more alchemy should fix this… right?

Wildixir is a fantasy survivor roguelite about dangerous alchemy. Combine automatic spells, dodge growing hordes, and discover powerful weapon evolutions as you fight through three corrupted lands.

• 3 playable alchemists with distinct styles
• 8 weapons, powerful evolutions, and passive formulas to shape your build
• 3 maps with different hazards and bosses
• Turn cleansed shrines into healing groves — or dangerous gardens for greater rewards
• Unlock new weapons and trials, and spend earned seeds on permanent upgrades
• Keyboard or gamepad
• 12 supported languages

Coming 4 November 2026 on Steam.
Developed by Alexframe.

#Wildixir #roguelite #bulletheaven #indiegame #godotengine
